rollups.text: Baking and cooking interests and projects: vegetarian cooking class at a local culinary school (began around 2022-02; reported 2022-03-13); Indian-inspired vegetarian feast made in class (week of 2022-03-06..2022-03-12); vegetable korma with tofu planned (2022-03-13); strawberry shortcake considered, including sourdough shortcake using bread flour (2022-03-21); strawberry-rhubarb crisp made a few weeks before 2022-04-10; lemon bars with shortbread crust made recently as of 2022-04-10; croissants planned again after an unsuccessful attempt (2022-04-10); banana bread with walnuts made recently as of 2022-04-10; chocolate cake with espresso powder baked for a friend's birthday (2022-04-02..2022-04-03); sourdough bread used for dinner-party sandwiches (reported 2022-04-10); matcha tiramisu, salted caramel chocolate tart, sourdough sandwiches, and lemon bars considered for a dinner party (2022-04-16..2022-04-17); large pot of beef stew made and partly frozen (2022-04-02..2022-04-03); beef stroganoff with leftover beef planned (2022-04-10).

Plants and gardening: the user owns a spider plant and repotted it around 2022-03-20; by 2022-04-10 it was doing better. The user considered getting a snake plant and a peace lily, asked about their care and low-light suitability, and expressed interest in beginner gardening and low-maintenance plants. Succulents, basil, mint, thyme, tomatoes, zinnias, and lavender were suggested as beginner-friendly options, but the user did not say they acquired them.

Music and creative music-making: the user enjoys Alex G covers on YouTube, especially his rendition of Adele's “Someone Like You,” and was interested in indie and acoustic cover artists (2022-03-05). The user has recently listened to a lot of music to relax and finds rain sounds relaxing (2022-03-05). The user plays acoustic guitar and works on fingerstyle finger independence, aiming for at least 30 minutes of practice every other day but reporting inconsistent practice (2022-04-10). The user experimented with Ableton Live and planned an indie-electronic track using Drum Rack, Simpler, Serum, and Arturia Pigments (2022-04-10).

Munich exchange preparations: by 2022-03-11, the user said they had been preparing since February 2022 for an exchange program at the University of Munich (LMU) and would move to Munich soon. They had found a city-center apartment through WG-Gesucht and selected Allianz Care for health insurance, understood to be accepted in Germany. They had opened a Deutsche Bank account on July 10 to receive scholarship payments; the year of that date was not specified. They were looking forward to exploring Munich and its restaurants and cafes. The records do not establish that the move or exchange took place.

Wedding with Alex: Alex proposed during a romantic getaway to Big Sur in 2021, using the user's grandmother's engagement ring redesigned for the proposal. By 2022-04-10, the user and Alex were planning a small, intimate wedding with close friends and family, probably in the San Diego area where Alex's family lives, with a relaxed coastal feel. They had browsed venues online but had not visited them. The user was especially looking forward to exchanging vows and thought personal vows might make the ceremony more personal; the couple had not decided between personal and traditional vows.

Aquarium and fish care: around 2022-03-20, the user set up a 20-gallon freshwater aquarium in the living room, later naming the tank Serenity. By 2022-04-10, the user described it as containing neon tetras, harlequin rasboras, and corydoras catfish. A corydoras named Mr. Whiskers had fin rot; the user reported daily water changes and medicated food and was concerned about adding dwarf gouramis before the fish recovered. The user was also considering low-maintenance plants and a water-testing kit. No later recovery or addition of fish or plants is recorded.

Spider plant care: the user repotted their spider plant around 2022-03-20 and felt more confident caring for a new plant afterward. By 2022-04-10, the plant was doing much better and had more room to grow; the user also asked about its ideal humidity and ways to maintain it.

Meditation practice: on 2022-04-10, the user asked how to begin Vipassana and was unsure whether to watch the breath or notice sensations. After trying daily breath focus for 30 minutes for a couple of days, the user said they were becoming more comfortable. Earlier, the user had found sitting for 20–30 minutes painful and boring and had a wandering mind. The assistant suggested starting shorter and increasing gradually; the user later asked about compassion meditation. The records do not establish a continuing practice beyond those few days.

Farm management app concept: on 2022-03-14, the user asked to add alerts and notifications to the pest-and-disease component. The proposed design included stored notification details, alerts when pests or disease are detected, unread counts, a notification list, marking notices read, and navigation to the relevant management page. The broader proposed app included farm activities, finances, harvest forecasts, worker tracking, training, marketplace, pest and disease detection, and alerts. The user also asked to add drone features for status and control, aerial crop assessment, mapping, damage and irrigation detection, alerts, and historical data. These were proposed features, not confirmed implementation.

Kodian Frontier Rangers grav-bike support concept: on 2022-04-10, the user was developing a Deployment Recovery and Repair Team (DRRT) operating from a Fast Heavy Lift Transport (FHLT) converted with a grav-bike garage. Proposed roles covered team leadership, bike recovery, field repairs, logistics and inventory, refueling, and FHLT crew coordination and maintenance. The stated purpose was to deploy, recover, and repair grav-bikes so the Rangers' fleet remained mission-ready on the forest moon.

Travel and outings: the user took a solo road trip from Portland to San Francisco in early April 2022, driving about 10 hours and stopping in Ashland for lunch. The user planned a 4–5-day road trip to North Cascades National Park with a stop in Leavenworth, preferred staying downtown there near shops and restaurants, and was interested in German cuisine. The user also planned to visit Maastricht and said they would check out food-spot suggestions; no dates were provided for that visit.

Household food shopping and meal planning: on 2022-04-04, the user spent around $20 at Trader Joe's on fresh produce, and said its cauliflower gnocchi was surprisingly good and a favorite purchase. On 2022-04-09, the user again reported spending around $20 at Trader Joe's on produce, including apples, bananas, berries, carrots, broccoli, and cauliflower. The user prefers recipes under 30 minutes and appreciates meal prep that reheats well; they planned cauliflower gnocchi stir-fry and a roasted vegetable bowl. The user packs work lunches and made quinoa salad and roasted vegetables, and also made a large batch of pasta sauce using Costco ingredients. A budgeting app showed about $250 spent on groceries during the two weeks before 2022-04-10; the user was planning meals and grocery lists to reduce food waste and stay within budget.
The user reported two recent Trader Joe's produce-shopping trips in early April 2022, each costing around $20: one on 2022-04-04 and another reported for 2022-04-09.

Online shopping tracking and deal-seeking: on 2022-04-10, the user had started gathering online order history to organize shopping and track spending, after receiving a Zara clothing order. The user said they tend to shop more during sales and after receiving a paycheck, already followed favorite brands on social media, and used deal-tracking websites. They had been shopping on ASOS frequently, especially during sales, and had recently bought many dresses; they particularly liked ASOS Design floral midi dresses and wanted to buy more during the next sale. The user said they would check out browser extensions and shopping apps for deal tracking, but no use of these tools is confirmed.

Creativity course development: on 2022-04-10, the user continued developing a course titled “Developing Creativity: A 6-Week Program.” Week 1 covered creativity, imagination, brainstorming, emotions, spirituality, mindset, self-prompting, and an application formula. The user then requested Week 2 in the same format and asked for its main content to be expanded in a Napoleon Hill tone; the resulting material addressed mental conditioning and creative mindset. The user next requested Week 3 in the same format, covering the subconscious mind, affirmations, visualization, meditation, mindfulness, journaling, and creative writing.

Revell F-15E Strike Eagle model build: on 2022-04-10, the user was building a pre-ordered Revell 1/48 F-15E Strike Eagle kit, had assembled the cockpit and fuselage, and worked on it in short sessions after dinner. The user planned to paint the exterior with Vallejo Model Air paints and sought weathering advice. They were considering the Vallejo USAF Fighter Jets paint set and whether the Modern US Military Aircraft set would be redundant; the assistant described overlapping and set-specific colors. The records do not establish that the model was completed or that either paint set was purchased.

The user also sought educational science and technology channels. No later change in viewing habits is recorded.

The user tried on their grandmother's old diamond necklace during a visit on the weekend of 2022-03-05..2022-03-06; it fit perfectly and sparkled. The user's engagement ring was the user's grandmother's ring, redesigned by Alex for the 2021 proposal. The user considered resizing the engagement ring and planned to ask their jewelry-loving sister for advice, considered buying a jewelry armoire, and wanted to keep jewelry safe on an upcoming trip. No armoire purchase or ring resizing is recorded.
